resume: SPAMPY is a synthwave groovebox built on Felucca and SLOOP: synth tracks and a 16-sound drum machine on the white keys, scenes, effects, a NEON arpeggiator and built-in arcade games. Each button has two lives: tapped, it opens its pages; held, a layer where the white keys and knobs change role.

commandes.role: Synth octave; on the drums, held: ghost hits. With EDIT held: undo.
Octave up; on the drums, held: strong hits. With EDIT held: redo.
Tapped: the effect pages. Held: the punch-in layer, one effect per white key.
Tapped: the scale pages. Held: the key and chord layer.
Tapped: the engine pages. Held: the erase layer.
Tapped: the global pages. Held: the mix layer (mute, solo, tap tempo, levels).
Tapped: the TRACKS screen, then the visualizer. Held: the menu (where the games are too). Tapped while a layer is held: locks it.
Tapped: the song screen or the save pages. Held: the song layer.
Tapped: the arpeggiator pages. Held: the note repeat layer.
Tapped: the sequencer pages. Held: the step layer, the white keys are the steps.
Tapped: records. Held: erases the track.
The tempo, or the previous or next page.
The selected track's sound, or the drum kit.
Play the track: on the drums, 16 sounds. In a held layer, their role changes (effects, steps, key, mix).

gestes: A button held: its layer; released, you play again. Held + HOME tapped: the layer stays open.
EDIT + OCT- or OCT+: undo or redo.
a_savoir: Based on SLOOP 2.7: its full guide (GUIDE.md) details every page.
